text_block_list.text:
Jul ※, Noon | Wind: Humid "First, Fill Yer 
Belly!" 
========================================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
The fun summer training camp begins! The 
base-building is going well, and according 
to the Navigator, everything will be set 
up by the end of the year.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Some of our friends couldn't make it 
because of camp costs or summer classes, 
but the rest of us just gotta give it 
everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Or so I thought, but everyone around here 
has such stormy long faces. What's the 
matter, summer fatigue? Eat some of my 
special paella and cheer up!
